bottom_line: In 4628 patients with atrial fibrillation, dronedarone (400 mg twice a day) vs placebo reduced the primary outcome of first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death (hazard ratio 0.76, 95% CI 0.69 to 0.84).
implications: These data support that, versus placebo, dronedarone reduced the composite of first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death (0.76, 95% CI 0.69 to 0.84; P<0.001) and reduced cardiovascular death (0.71, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.98; P=0.03), while not demonstrating a statistically significant reduction in all-cause death (0.84, 95% CI 0.66 to 1.08; P=0.18); bradycardia (3.5% vs 1.2%), QT-interval prolongation (1.7% vs 0.6%), diarrhea (9.7% vs 6.2%), nausea (5.3% vs 3.1%), rash (3.4% vs 2.0%) and serum creatinine increase (4.7% vs 1.3%) were more frequent with dronedarone.

major_points.text: Multicenter randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in patients with atrial fibrillation and additional risk factors.
major_points.quote: ATHENA was a randomized, double- blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted accord- ing to the Declaration of Helsinki at 551 centers in 37 countries.

major_points.text: 4628 patients were randomized to dronedarone 400 mg twice daily or placebo.
major_points.quote: We conducted a multicenter trial to evaluate the use of dronedarone in 4628 patients with atrial fibrillation who had additional risk factors for death. Patients were ran- domly assigned to receive dronedarone, 400 mg twice a day, or placebo.

major_points.text: Primary outcome was first hospitalization due to cardiovascular events or death from any cause.
major_points.quote: The primary study outcome was the first hospi- talization due to cardiovascular events or death from any cause.

major_points.text: Primary outcome occurred less often with dronedarone than placebo (HR 0.76, P<0.001).
major_points.quote: The primary outcome occurred in 734 patients (31.9%) in the dronedarone group and in 917 patients (39.4%) in the placebo group, with a hazard ratio for drone- darone of 0.76 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.69 to 0.84; P<0.001).

major_points.text: Death from any cause was not significantly different between groups (HR 0.84; P=0.18).
major_points.quote: There were 116 deaths (5.0%) in the dronedarone group and 139 (6.0%) in the placebo group (haz- ard ratio, 0.84; 95% CI, 0.66 to 1.08; P = 0.18).

major_points.text: Death from cardiovascular causes was lower with dronedarone (HR 0.71; P=0.03).
major_points.quote: There were 63 deaths from cardiovas- cular causes (2.7%) in the dronedarone group and 90 (3.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.71; 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.98; P = 0.03)

major_points.text: Deaths from cardiac arrhythmia were lower with dronedarone (HR 0.55; P=0.01).
major_points.quote: There were 26 deaths from cardiac arrhythmia (in 1.1% of patients) in the dronedarone group and 48 (in 2.1%) in the pla- cebo group (hazard ratio, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.34 to 0.88; P = 0.01)

major_points.text: Premature discontinuation of study drug was common and similar between groups (~30%).
major_points.quote: The mean follow-up period was 21±5 months, with the study drug discontinued prematurely in 696 of the 2301 patients (30.2%) receiving dronedarone and in 716 of the 2327 patients (30.8%) receiving placebo

major_points.text: Selected adverse events were more common with dronedarone, including bradycardia, QT prolongation, diarrhea, nausea, rash, and creatinine increase.
major_points.quote: Bradycardia, QT-interval pro- longation, diarrhea, nausea, rash, and an increase in the serum creatinine level were significantly more common in the dronedarone group than in the placebo group.

inclusion_criteria.text: Paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation or flutter with at least one specified risk factor (e.g., age criteria, hypertension, diabetes, prior stroke/TIA/systemic embolism, LA diameter ≥50 mm, or LVEF ≤40%).
inclusion_criteria.quote: Patients with paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibril- lation or flutter were eligible if they met at least one of the following requirements: age of at least 70 years; arterial hypertension

inclusion_criteria.text: 12-lead ECG showing atrial fibrillation or flutter within 6 months before randomization had to be available.
inclusion_criteria.quote: For each patient, a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) showing atrial fibrilla- tion or flutter and obtained within 6 months be- fore randomization had to be available.

inclusion_criteria.text: A second 12-lead ECG within the same period had to show sinus rhythm.
inclusion_criteria.quote: A second 12-lead ECG within the same period had to show sinus rhythm.

exclusion_criteria.quote: Patients were ineligible for participation in the trial if they had any of the following cardiac con- ditions: permanent atrial fibrillation;

exclusion_criteria.text: Decompensated heart failure within the previous 4 weeks (unstable hemodynamic condition).
exclusion_criteria.quote: an unstable hemodynamic condition (i.e., decompensated heart failure within the previous 4 weeks);

exclusion_criteria.text: NYHA class IV congestive heart failure.
exclusion_criteria.quote: New York Heart Association (NYHA) class IV congestive heart failure;

exclusion_criteria.text: Bradycardia with heart rate <50 beats per minute or PR interval >0.28 second.
exclusion_criteria.quote: bradycardia with a heart rate of less than 50 beats per minute or a PR interval of more than 0.28 second;

exclusion_criteria.text: Calculated glomerular filtration rate at baseline <10 ml per minute.
exclusion_criteria.quote: a calculated glomerular filtration rate at baseline of less than 10 ml per minute;

exclusion_criteria.quote: a requirement for concomi- tant medication that was prohibited (i.e., other class I or III antiarrhythmic drugs).

criticisms.text: Rate of premature discontinuation was very high (30.2% in dronedarone group), which may have underestimated benefit and limited ability to demonstrate adverse events.
criticisms.quote: Another limitation of this trial is that the rate of premature discontinuation of the study drug was very high (30.2% in the dronedarone group). This may have resulted in an underestimate of the benefit of dronedarone

criticisms.text: No other antiarrhythmic agent has been evaluated in a large trial for this outcome, so relative efficacy or safety vs other drugs is unknown.
criticisms.quote: Therefore, it is not possible to know the relative efficacy or safety of dronedarone as com- pared with other drugs for this outcome.
